_comment: Re-voices an existing WAV into a smaller, higher, breathier speaker.
The three moves that read as 'child' act on different axes, which is the
timbre.vocal_tract_scale    0.86 shortens the tract 14%, pushing all
source.aspiration_db_delta  -16.0 adds breath noise 16 dB below the
signal peak, so the voice sounds less
Raising pitch alone sounds like a pitch-shifted adult; raising pitch AND
formants together is what changes the apparent size of the speaker.
pitch.range_compress 1.15 widens the speaker's own F0 range 15%, which
adds to the youthful, less monotone impression.
